name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation maintains the topic and context of the conversation. It evaluates if the response is coherent and relevant to the previous conversation turn.

name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically consistent and well-structured the generated continuation is. It evaluates if the response makes sense and flows naturally from the previous conversation turn.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how interesting and engaging the generated continuation is. It evaluates if the response encourages further conversation or discussion.

name: Grammaticality
description: Measures the grammatical correctness of the generated continuation. It evaluates if the response is free of grammatical errors and adheres to the rules of language.

name: Factuality
description: Measures the factual accuracy of the generated continuation. It evaluates if the response is based on correct and verifiable information.

name: Diversity
description: Measures the variety and creativity of the generated continuation. It evaluates if the response introduces new ideas or perspectives, rather than repeating or paraphrasing the previous conversation turn.

name: Politeness
description: Measures the level of politeness and respect exhibited in the generated continuation. It evaluates if the response is considerate and respectful towards the other conversation participant.
